desc: Ideal for illuminating hard-to-see areas of the chamber, receiver and barrel interior. A bright white LED puts out 15,000 Mcd brightness with a 5" flex neck is attached to the machined barrel. This little gem of a light also has an embedded magnet. Simply set the Bore Light on the barrel, rib or receiver to leave both hands free to work. The flex neck holds position even in the smallest hard-to-light areas. Push-button on/off. Uses three 3 LR44 button cell batteries (included). Non stop run time for 8 amazing hours.
